prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production pixel art game spritesheet from reference character. Preserve EXACTLY his recognizable smiling face, dark brown skin, short curly black hair, short black beard, broad heavyset stocky body with large round bare belly, barefoot, gold necklace and gold details. CHANGE ONLY costume colors to DARK NAVY BLUE martial arts jacket and trousers, keep belt/sash pure WHITE with grey shadows, keep embroidered gold/yellow crown, triangle badge and hem trim. All frames of body face LEFT, reflect reference direction horizontally! Same dark navy palette across all poses. Never make him thin, never alter his face or belly. True transparent RGBA background, no white border, no checkerboard. Crisp premium pixel art with readable detailed face and consistent proportions. EXACTLY EIGHT equally spaced COLUMNS and SEVEN ROWS, 56 full-body drawings. All figures same scale, stable bare feet baseline, wide transparent gutters in all directions. No text/no labels. Each row 8 coherent chronological DIFFERENT drawings: ready, preparation, windup, anticipation, peak action, follow-through, recover, ready (same ready pose as idle row1col1). No duplicate poses except intentional loop closure. Keep whole body, crown/yellow details, white sash visible in every frame.
Row1: idle breathing loop, guard fists relaxed in front, subtle belly/shoulder motion, no growth/shrink.
Row2: taking damage, guard then slight flinch, stronger recoil backward to RIGHT (enemy faces LEFT), peak recoil, regain footing, straighten, recover, ready.
Row3: belly charge attack LEFT, arms open preparation, lean backward right, crouch windup, thrust huge belly/shoulder LEFT at frame5 with small gold contact arc and dust, follow-through, recoil, ready. No long travel inside cell.
Row4: throw GOLD COINS LEFT, hand at waist, gather handful of coins, windup right, extend hand and release LEFT at frame5, empty hand follow-through, lower hand, ready. NO detached remote coin cluster, independent projectile will be drawn by game.
Row5: BLUE energy palm wave LEFT, arms prepare, hands cup blue spark, hands together channel, push both palms LEFT at frame5 small local cyan burst, hold palms, relax, ready. NO detached remote projectile, only hands and local charge.
Row6: heal/buff holding gold pendant: ready, draw necklace pendant from chest, raise golden six-point star pendant by its chain, channel soft golden lights, golden healing aura and plus sparkles peak frame5, aura softens, lower pendant, ready. Gold aura only, no green. Still navy clothes and white belt.
Row7: dedicated FINAL BOSS ultimate Maré Soberana: ready, sink stance, gather grand BLUE-GOLD sphere between hands, brace immense power, launch both palms LEFT at frame5 with blue/gold local shock and flowing jacket, sustain and recoil, golden sparks fade, ready. Preserve fat belly, same recognizable original face/body. No giant separate wave in this row because game has independent VFX. High consistency and fluidity prioritized.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production PIXEL ART magic VFX sprite sheet on true TRANSPARENT background. This is for final boss Zanzara, reference shows his golden amulet, coins and blue palm wave; draw NO BODY and NO CHARACTER. EXACTLY FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS and THREE ROWS with generous transparent gutters, no letters/captions. All projectiles point LEFT, trailing streaks to RIGHT. Same detailed premium game pixel art as reference, bright cyan/royal blue energy with gold sparks. Row1 FOUR distinct ultimate Maré Soberana VFX: (1) circular golden six-point amulet/star medallion charging inside blue orbit, (2) imposing LEFT-facing blue/cyan shockwave crescent with gold orbiting coins and gold filaments trailing RIGHT, (3) even grander blue GOLD shockwave front with luminous cyan core and sharp gold sparks LEFT, (4) large circular BLUE/GOLD impact explosion ring with gold coin fragments dissolving. Row2 FOUR spinning golden coin fan projectile drawings, small cluster of 5 coins with short gold motion streaks to RIGHT, progressively rotated faces/edges, same cluster footprint. Row3 FOUR regular blue palm shockwave projectile drawings, curved cyan/blue energy crescents facing LEFT, short pale-blue trails RIGHT, coherent expanding wave sequence. No white background/checkerboard/white outlines. Every effect contained well within cell. Keep colors saturated and magical edges alpha-soft while pixel details crisp.
